brief: Run /ux-critique then /ux-design on the student exam-taking flow: src/app/(exam)/ (especially student/exam/[examId]/page.tsx and its components). Reduce cognitive load under time pressure: timer always visible but calm, question navigator scannable, answer states unmistakable (answered / flagged / unanswered). Proctoring camera tile: present but non-distracting; clear LIVE indicator; graceful when proctoring is disabled. Transitions between questions feel instant; autosave status communicated subtly. Mobile: usable on phones. Accessibility: keyboard navigation for questions, focus states, aria labels.
